app_description: On this page you can enter growth data and visualise it in comparison to a reference population. Please select the reference values to be used first and then enter sex, date of birth and the measured values to be visualised. The values are displayed in the graphics on the right (or below for mobile device users). Click on 'Height', 'Weight', and 'BMI' to switch between the different graphics. With the buttons at the bottom you can import existing data or export your entries and present them, for instance, to your family doctor.
privacy_note: The data entered on this page remains exclusively on your terminal device. Neither operators of this application nor other parties have access to your data at any time.
normal_turkish_germany: Germany (Turkish descent born, without chronic diseases)
target_height_description:
The target height is a rough estimation of the final hight your child might reach.
It is derived from father and mother height.
export_description: You have the following options for saving or exporting the data you have entered:
save_to_file_description: Create a file from your data that can for example be handed over to your family doctor.
show_qr_description: You can scan this QR code to get your entered data as JSON format. This format is machine-readable.
import_description: Load previously exported input data from a JSON file or string.
percentile_description: The lines p03, p50, and p97 are referred to as the 3rd, 50th, and 97th percentiles, respectively. For example, the 97th percentile indicates that 97% of all measured values lie below this line. A child whose measurement lies above the 97th percentile is therefore noticeably tall compared to children of the same age and gender. The child is among the tallest 3 percent.
parental_estimation_description: The parental expectation value is calculated based on both parental measures and the selected reference values. This is merely a guideline that can be used to estimate whether a child, for example, falls significantly below or above parental expectations.
